interface: Local isolated browser: four governance challenges selected without a limit; Next goes to the institutional diagnosis, with no tool trial screens.
Governance navigation: Context, Institutional diagnosis, Action plan and resources, Monitoring and review.
Budget: entering 1234.56 shows the same formatted subtotal in the resource question, live panel and plan, alongside six missing amounts.
Mixed priorities remain institutional until the user explicitly identifies an AI use project. Separate project and governance buttons preserve each front.
The tool project report uses the identified project title and excludes governance challenge IDs from its projection. Returning to governance preserves its budget.
National school/student totals are formatted by locale; the currency already associated with entered governance amounts is retained if the country changes.
regressions: Sandbox only for G15; saved sandbox data retained when the challenge is unselected.
All selected challenges create actions; existing G1-G10 IDs remain supported, along with other challenge text.
National totals and governance budget cannot change tool project costs.
New institutional answers, previous tool answers, stage data and saved position survive JSON export/import.
Unknown costs are not zero; zero, partial totals, complete totals and invalid imported amounts are distinguished.
